visualCharacteristics: Vertical stacked text-only link list in a light-blue box with a highlighted active item, used as section sub-navigation.
contentPattern: Side navigation list: one row per link to a page in the section; item count varies by page. The active item is derived from the current URL in block code. Placed in a 'split' section beside the article.
usage: Section sub-navigation in the left column of a 'split' section; author one link per row.
reuseGuidance: Use for text-only lists of links to sibling pages. For image cards use the base cards block.
